text:
sara: Quick ping — opened a small PR to change header merging behavior for streaming requests that invoke tool calls. TL;DR: preserve `x-request-id` across internal redirects and ensure streaming chunks don't drop toolcall headers. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2345

kevin: taking a look now, can you summarize the failure mode you hit?

sara: repro was flaky locally: streaming->toolcall would sometimes lose auth header when we re-emit pre-buffered chunks. Seen in trace where the toolcall handler sees no `x-request-id`. I added a small explicit propagation step and a unit test.

anthony: what's the delta on perf? any extra copies on hot path?

sara: negligible — just moves a reference into the outgoing metadata map instead of reconstructing. added a microbenchmark in the PR notes.

ci-bot: CI: linux-unit ✓, go-integration ✓, js-e2e ✗ (flake: websocket connect timeout). Rerun queued.

maria: read through — small nit: in the streaming adapter you check `if (hdrs.has('x-request-id'))` but later you call `hdrs.set(...)` unconditionally. If someone upstream uses a lowercase key variant it might duplicate. Recommend normalizing keys earlier (e.g., `lowercaseKeys(hdrs)`) or using a case-insensitive map.

sara: good call — I pushed a change to normalize keys at the adapter boundary and added a unit for uppercase header variants.

kevin: I left one inline suggestion about avoiding allocating a new buffer in `emitChunk` when `chunk.isFinal` is false. small comment, but could help 99th pct latency. snippet:```
// avoid copy
if (!chunk.isFinal) out = chunk.payload; else out = Buffer.concat([...]);
```

sara: updated to reuse payload buffer where safe. reran microbench, no regressions. thanks!

lina: assigning reviewers: @kevin and @maria — please 👍 when happy, I'll merge during the next quiet window.

kevin: will give a final pass after CI is fully green.

ci-bot: CI: js-e2e ✓ (re-run), all checks passed.

maria: ✅ looks good to me. covered the header cases I was worried about.

sara: awesome — thanks all. @kevin if you can approve when you have a minute I'll schedule the merge. :rocket:

kevin: approved and added a small changelog note. go ahead and merge when ready. :thumbsup:
